body_lead: Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh plans to establish India's first dedicated Artificial Intelligence (AI) university, state Education, IT, and Electronics Minister Nara Lokesh said. The minister, who is currently on a visit to Australia, also announced that AI curriculum is being introduced from the high school level, supported by new AI and Robotics Labs across government schools.
